newsitem.title: USA: Mazel Stores boosts IPO price terms.
newsitem.headline: Mazel Stores boosts IPO price terms.

text.p: Mazel Stores Inc has raised terms of its initial public offering by increasing both the number of shares to be offered and the estimated pricing range, according to a document filed today with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

The Solon, Ohio, company will offer 2.574 million shares expected to price in a range of $14 to $16 each. In September, the company estimated it would offer 2,145,000 shares in a range of $13 to $15 each.
That raises net proceeds of the deal by about $8.6 million. The company will offer all the shares and receive all the net proceeds from the initial public offering.
After the IPO, Mazel officers, directors and other affiliates will beneficially own about 66 percent of the stock of Mazel.
